prompt: A local bakery with 2 shops and €400/month for ads wants more weekday morning customers. Propose a 6-week plan with channels, budget split and the metric you would watch each week.
Write three subject lines and a 90-word email for a B2B invoicing SaaS re-engaging trial users who never connected their bank account. Explain the angle of each subject line.

Our D2C skincare brand has a 1.2% conversion rate on product pages and 68% mobile traffic. List the five experiments you would run first, ordered by expected impact per effort, with a hypothesis for each.
Una academia de idiomas online quiere captar adultos de 35 a 50 años en España. Define dos buyer personas con motivaciones, objeciones y el mensaje principal para cada una.
We sell a €9/month habit-tracking app. Monthly churn is 11%. Suggest a lifecycle messaging sequence for the first 30 days, with timing, channel and the goal of each message.

Explain how you would measure whether a podcast sponsorship worked for a niche project-management tool when listeners rarely click links. Include at least two measurement methods and their weaknesses.
Redacta un brief creativo de una página para la campaña de otoño de una cadena de ópticas que quiere atraer a estudiantes universitarios. Incluye insight, propuesta de valor, tono y entregables.
A furniture e-commerce site sees search traffic drop 30% after a site migration. Give a prioritized diagnostic checklist and what evidence would confirm each cause.
Compare a freemium model and a 14-day free trial for a design-collaboration tool aimed at small agencies. Recommend one and state what data would change your mind.
Write a positioning statement and three proof points for an open-source, self-hosted analytics product competing with large hosted suites, for privacy-conscious European SMEs.
Un hotel rural de 12 habitaciones tiene 85% de ocupación en verano y 30% en invierno. Propón tres campañas para temporada baja con público objetivo, oferta y canal.
Our LinkedIn ads for an HR compliance tool get a 0.9% CTR but leads rarely book demos. What might be wrong between click and demo, and how would you test each hypothesis?
Design a referral program for a meal-kit startup with €35 average order value and 42% gross margin. Specify the reward, how you keep it profitable, and fraud safeguards.
Write landing-page copy (headline, subheadline, three benefit bullets, CTA) for a bookkeeping service for freelance photographers. Keep it under 120 words.
We have budget for either a brand video or performance ads for the next quarter for a regional insurance broker. How should we decide? Lay out the trade-offs and a decision rule.
Crea un calendario de contenidos de cuatro semanas para Instagram de una tienda de bicicletas urbanas en Valencia, con formato, tema y objetivo de cada publicación (dos por semana).
A mobile game's day-1 retention is 38% but day-7 is 6%. Which marketing and onboarding changes would you investigate, and which in-app events would you instrument first?
Estimate the serviceable addressable market for a scheduling app for independent physiotherapists in Germany. Show your assumptions explicitly and how you would validate the two weakest ones.
Rewrite this tagline to be more specific and credible, giving three options and why each works: 'The best software for your business.' The product is a stock-management tool for hardware stores.
Una ONG local quiere aumentar sus socios recurrentes un 20% este año con un presupuesto mínimo. Propón una estrategia con acciones concretas, responsables y métricas trimestrales.
Our newsletter has 18k subscribers, 22% open rate and 1.1% click rate. Propose a segmentation scheme and two tests to raise clicks, and say how big a sample each test needs to be meaningful.
Outline a go-to-market plan for a hardware startup launching a €249 smart thermostat in Spain, covering channels, pricing communication, launch sequence and the first three KPIs.
A coffee chain wants to respond to a viral negative review about rude staff. Draft a public reply and an internal action list, and explain what to avoid saying.
Explain the difference between marketing-mix modelling and multi-touch attribution to a CFO who must choose one for a €2M annual ad budget, and recommend a starting approach.
